svg.aria-label: \begin{aligned} \lvert BV(s)-BV'(s)\rvert &=\left|\max_a\sum_{s'}T(s,a,s')\left[R(s,a,s')+\gamma V(s')\right] -\max_a\sum_{s'}T(s,a,s')\left[R(s,a,s')+\gamma V'(s')\right]\right|\\ &\le\max_a\left|\sum_{s'}T(s,a,s')\left[R(s,a,s')+\gamma V(s')\right] -\sum_{s'}T(s,a,s')\left[R(s,a,s')+\gamma V'(s')\right]\right|\\ &=\gamma\max_a\left|\sum_{s'}T(s,a,s')\left[V(s')-V'(s')\right]\right|\\ &\le\gamma\max_a\sum_{s'}T(s,a,s')\max_{s''}\lvert V(s'')-V'(s'')\rvert\\ &=\gamma\max_{s'}\lvert V(s')-V'(s')\rvert\\ &=\gamma\lVert V-V'\rVert_\infty。 \end{aligned}
